notes.title: Version 1.2 - Art Update
notes.content:
Version 1.2 of A Pinch of Magic is here! This small update includes a few fixes and an art update- sprite tints!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40180003/66ee9004ef586be8d2b0627947265073ef7955fb.png[/img]

Now, depending on the scene, the artwork will better match it. At the beach at sunset with Kiana or Mikhail? Now you're pinker! Working late at night at the café? Now it looks more like nighttime!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40180003/871a039683060c7ea0d64c5fcc64612ec7e62a71.png[/img]

Thank you everyone who's played A Pinch of Magic so far! We released it just under a year ago for the NaNoRenO visual novel game jam where we made it in one month and now it's been downloaded over 50,000 times since.

[h3]If you're interested in reading more about how it was made, you can [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/category/a-pinch-of-magic/]check out the devlogs here[/url].[/h3]

notes.title: A Pinch of Magic has released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40180003/521c5bc199d2bb22d3c5f83f8a562940e12389f9.png[/img]

A Pinch of Magic has now released on Steam- thank you for checking it out! This visual novel was made for the annual NaNoRenO visual novel jam where developers are tasked with making a VN in one month. For a full list of everyone who worked on A Pinch of Magic, you can check out the [b][url=https://crystalgameworks.com/visual-novels/a-pinch-of-magic/]team list on our website[/url][/b].

During March and April we also released several developer blogs and commentaries on how the game was being made- some of these are about concept designs, some are about writing, etc. You can view all of the [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/category/a-pinch-of-magic/][b]developer insights on our website[/b][/url] as well.

[url=https://crystalgameworks.com/a-pinch-of-magic-writers-qa/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40180003/74ab547d771f87414e825da7892e2fd523370257.png[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy A Pinch of Magic- again, thank you for checking it out!
